name: octopus-hardware
description: Universal hardware control platform. Octopus auto-discovers hardware connected to a computer (robotic arms, cameras, GPIO, sensors, actuators) and generates an MCP API for controlling them. Use action=list to see available tools, action=invoke to call any tool.

functionDefinition.name: octopus-hardware
functionDefinition.description:
Control real hardware through the Octopus MCP bridge. Two modes:
1. List tools: pass {"action": "list"} to see all available hardware tools
2. Invoke tool: pass {"action": "invoke", "tool_name": "...", "parameters": {...}} to control hardware

Always call with action=list first to get current tool names — they vary by hardware configuration. Example tools: arm_set_joint_angle, usb_camera_capture_image, gpio_set_gpio_state, wifi_scan_wifi_networks.

action.description: list = show available tools; invoke = call a specific tool

tool_name.description: Tool to invoke (required when action=invoke). Get names from action=list.

parameters.description: Parameters for the tool (required when action=invoke). Structure depends on the tool.
